[size=150][b]Lionheart Fixt 0.25.3 - Fernand can be taken back[/b][/size]

Reported from play: *"fernand cannot rejoin the party if we release companion."*

He could not. Once dismissed, Fernand Desoto was gone for the rest of the run.

[b]What was happening[/b]

Recruiting him fires the [i]fernand joins you[/i] relay in [i]Port District.zax[/i], which swaps his [i]CSkeletonAI[/i]
for a follow AI and [b]replaces his [i]CAIInteractionSpecifier[/i][/b] with one that opens his tree at a single
node:

    Node ID=100 companion banter
    Text=Where you go, I follow.
    Should Have Voiceover=0

No replies. And nothing anywhere restores the specifier he had before.

A reply-less conversation node is [b]not[/b] a defect on its own -- a sweep found 49 of them opened as
conversations across the game, most of them vanilla's own ambient one-liners: [i]Bar Patrons[/i],
[i]ToulouseOgres[/i], [i]ShylockeGoons[/i]'s shop loop. The engine shows the line and closes. Node 100 was
behaving exactly as the game intends.

The defect is narrower and worse. That node is his [b]only[/b] interaction for the rest of the game, and it
offers no path anywhere. The recruit reply -- *"I would like you to accompany me for a time"* -- lives
back on [i]1 return after saving juan[/i], and his specifier no longer points there. Release him and there is
no way to ask again.

[b]The fix[/b]

Node 100 now carries the route back: [b]dismiss[/b], [b]rejoin[/b], and a default goodbye. Two new nodes hold
his answers.

Both replies are deliberately [b]ungated[/b]. A marker set on dismissal would be tidier, and is the idiom
this project uses elsewhere ([i]Grace has been left behind[/i]) -- but it only works when the release goes
through dialogue, and this was reported by a player who had *already* released him. A marker-gated
rejoin would have left exactly the people who hit the bug unable to use the fix. Releasing someone who
is not following, and recruiting someone who already is, are both no-ops, so the cost is one slightly
odd line and the benefit is that he is recoverable from any state.

The recruit gate at node [i]40 companion[/i] -- Speech 20 or Barter 20 -- is [b]not[/b] re-applied. He was
persuaded once and says himself that the debt is unpaid; charging it twice would strand a character who
spent those points earlier.

[b]No map edit.[/b] His specifier already points at node 100; that node is now worth arriving at.

[b]The pattern this makes three of[/b]

This is the third companion in three releases whose *leaving* half was incomplete. Grumdjum's rejoin and
the Alamut knight's rejoin were two of the eleven self-referencing trees in 0.25.2, and Grace's
dismissal balloon was another. The joining half gets built and walked; the leaving half gets written and
never tested.

Every remaining companion is on the list to be checked the same way before the next feature release.

[b]Fixt[/b] is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run [i]Mod Manager.bat[/i]. This one is a dialogue repair and applies to any character,
including a save where Fernand is already following or already dismissed. If you have any earlier
release installed, replace it.

https://github.com/EricHype/LionheartFixt/releases/tag/v0.25.3
